articles.title: Records Shatter as UK Swelters Through Hottest May Day in History
articles.summary: The UK recorded its hottest May temperature ever — 34.8°C in London — surpassing a 2019 record. Wales also set a new high. Health alerts are in effect, and some events were canceled to protect animals from the extreme heat.

articles.title: In Historic First, Pope Apologizes for Vatican's Role in Legitimizing Slavery
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV issued an unprecedented apology for the Holy See's role in authorizing the enslavement of non-Christians during the colonial era. The apology, in his first encyclical, acknowledges past papal decrees that explicitly permitted slavery.

articles.title: Amid War and Energy Crisis, Over 1.5 Million Begin Hajj Pilgrimage
articles.summary: More than 1.5 million Muslims have arrived in Mecca for the annual Hajj, one of Islam's five pillars. The pilgrimage unfolds against a backdrop of a fragile Iran ceasefire and global energy turmoil, but pilgrims remain focused on spiritual transformation.
